acceptanceCriteria: A go-test step that fails in one resolved package records a pass for every other resolved package that passed, keyed as GL-V0-001 requires, and a rerun on the same tree runs only the failed package plus the unresolved set.
gate-ledger-v0.md amends GL-V0-002 for per-package records, with a test that a failed package is never recorded.
body: During the 0.8.1 release, one flaky test failed the go-test step. GL-V0-002 records only a step that exits zero, and the 101 resolved packages run in one go test invocation, so the rerun repeated about 100 packages that had passed on byte-identical inputs. Parsing go test -json per package would let a failed invocation still record the packages that passed.
